text: {"differences": [{"side": "tgt", "quote": "Il a été ambassadeur de Suisse en Turquie de 2017 à 2021 et, de 2012 à 2017, directeur suppléant de la Direction des affaires européennes du Département fédéral des affaires étrangères (DFAE), où il était notamment chargé des questions économiques et sectorielles dans les relations de la Suisse avec l’UE.", "severity": 0.2, "before": "From 2017 to 2021, Ambassador of Switzerland to Turkey and from 2012 to 2017, deputy director of the Directorate for European Affairs of the Federal Department of Foreign Affairs (FDFA), where he was in particular responsible for the economic and sectoral matters of Swiss relations with the EU."}, {"side": "en", "quote": "In 2010/2011, he headed the Section for Humanitarian Policy and Migration in the FDFA’s Peace and Human Rights Division.", "severity": 0.2, "before": "In 2010/2011, he headed the Section for Humanitarian Policy and Migration in the FDFA’s Peace and Human Rights Division."}]}
